questions.stem: Which profession makes Superior and Major Healing Potions in Forever?
questions.explanation: Superior and Major Healing Potions are now First Aid crafts; the old Alchemy healing-potion recipes are gone.

questions.stem: At what Alchemy skill can you place the Alchemy Laboratory camp object?
questions.explanation: The Mana Well comes at skill 20, the Fermenter at 140 and the Alchemy Laboratory at 300.

questions.stem: What does Artisan Alchemy training need?
questions.explanation: Journeyman needs skill 50 and level 10, Expert skill 125 and level 20, and Artisan skill 200 and level 35.

questions.stem: Up to what skill does Expert Alchemy go?
questions.explanation: Apprentice goes up to 75, Journeyman up to 150, Expert up to 225 and Artisan up to 300.

questions.stem: How long do the new Favor elixirs last?
questions.explanation: The new Favor elixirs last 30 minutes. Potion of Elemental Purging lasts 5 minutes and the Major Frenzy Potion 30 s.

questions.stem: Which Favor elixir gives +25 Strength and +2% crit?
questions.explanation: Grizzly gives +25 Strength and +2% crit; Owl gives +25 Intellect and +2% crit; Cunning +25 Agility and Intellect.

questions.stem: In Classic 1.12, what Alchemy skill does the Greater Fire Protection Potion recipe need?
questions.explanation: In Classic 1.12 the recipe drops in Blackrock Spire and needs Alchemy 290. Forever has not confirmed it.

questions.stem: How many Magenta Dye does a Runecloth Bag take in Forever?
questions.explanation: The Runecloth Bag now takes 4 Magenta and 2 Cerulean Dye.
